name: report_intent_findings
description: Report every intent finding: changes in the plan the requests did not ask for, and parts of the requests the plan does not address. Call it exactly once; it ends the check. If the plan matches the requests, report an empty violations list.

violations.description: Every intent violation found, one per rule and resource. Empty when the plan does exactly what the requests ask.

rule_id.description: The declared id of the rule that was broken.

resource.description: Terraform resource address the finding is about (e.g. azurerm_storage_account.main), or null when it concerns no single resource.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the change or the missing part of the request, and why it breaks the rule.

suggested_fix.description: How to fix the violation, or null if no specific fix is suggested.

summary.description: One or two sentences, at most 300 characters, stating whether the plan matches the requests and the main reason. Do not list the change inventory here; each problem belongs in violations.

checked_rules.description: Every rule_id evaluated, including the ones that passed.
